Uniswap’s StablePair hook adjusts fees around a configured reference rate. Outside its band, swaps classified as moving away from that rate pay no LP fee; corrective swaps face a fee that decays over time.

The reference is set through governance, not a live market feed. If a coin weakens, LPs can end up holding more of it and fee income may not cover that loss. The article reports no depeg or exploit. Pool volume cannot establish realized LP returns without comparable fee and inventory data.

📄 Iran rejects reports on timing of delegation’s departure from New York

📌 New York, IRNA – The Iranian mission to the United Nations has rejected claims surrounding the timing of the departure of the Iranian delegation headed by Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi from New York.

In a statement on Wednesday, Iran’s mission to the UN said, “The Iranian delegation left New York on Monday evening, in accordance with the schedule that had also been communicated to the U.S. Department of State in advance on September 17.”
​
“Having achieved nothing, the State Department has resorted to propagating baseless and worthless news,” the mission added.
​
Earlier, Axios quoted a source as claiming that the United States had asked the Iranian delegation to leave New York, while the same source acknowledged that Araghchi had already been scheduled to return to Tehran on Monday evening.
​
The delegation had traveled to the United States to attend the 81st annual session of the United Nations General Assembly.
